item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 17/Mar/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh easterly airstream will reach the coast of Guangdong later tomorrow. Under the influence of a southerly airstream, it will be warm and humid with showers over the coastal areas early to midweek next week. A trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to southern China in the latter part of next week. Showers will increase and there will be thunderstorms over the coastal areas of Guangdong.
